name: Belgium
visaRequirements: Schengen visa rules apply for many travelers; check current requirements before booking
bestExperience: Best experience: hopping between hot chocolate shops — the ginger-and-chilli mix in particular still lives in my head rent-free.

about.description: Belgium blends medieval cities, world-class chocolate, and lively squares. Its compact size makes it perfect for a quick, immersive European escape.
highlights: Cobblestone streets and medieval architecture in Bruges and Ghent
Art nouveau and diamond districts in Antwerp

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: April to October when the weather is mild and outdoor cafés are open
transportation: Efficient train network between major cities
Trams and metros in Brussels and Antwerp
culturalNotes: Sample local specialties like moules-frites and Belgian waffles
Learn a few greetings in French or Dutch for a warm response
Take your time at cafés—Belgium has a strong café culture
